sample_unit: patients with paired gated and nongated CT scans (plus 8052 low-dose CT patients in a simulated screening cohort)

links.outcome: Cardiologist review of sampled high-CAC AI outputs for appropriateness of lipid-lowering therapy
links.effect: Four cardiologists verified that 527 of 531 (99.2%) reviewed AI-CAC >400 LDCT patients would benefit from lipid-lowering therapy.
links.quote: Four cardiologists qualitatively reviewed a random sample of the >400 AI-CAC LDCT patients and verified that 527 of the 531 (99.2%) would benefit from lipid-lowering therapy.

screen.reason: Evaluates a deep learning model for opportunistic coronary artery calcium screening on retrospective chest CT data across a multi-center VA dataset, including a clinician review of flagged cases, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
